headline: I break unmanned aircraft so they can be built to survive.
bio_short: UAS and embedded security researcher focused on the parts of a drone that rarely get audited: the RF link, the flight-controller firmware, and the onboard network. Credited on two MITRE CVEs and the maintainer of this reference.

focus_areas.name: RF & Link Security
focus_areas.summary: MAVLink, OcuSync, Remote ID, and the unencrypted-by-default reality of drone control links.

focus_areas.name: Firmware & Embedded
focus_areas.summary: Debug-port access, firmware extraction, and control-protocol memory safety (DUML and friends).

focus_areas.name: Onboard Network
focus_areas.summary: Exposed Telnet/RTSP/HTTP services on the airframe AP, and the auth that should have been there.

focus_areas.name: Detection Engineering
focus_areas.summary: Turning offensive findings into shippable Suricata, Zeek, and YARA content defenders can deploy.
